reviews.author: Sara Maria Andres Hernandez
reviews.text: (Translated by Google) I usually really like ramen, but this one was a huge disappointment. There are tons of TikToks recommending it, but it's all fake advertising. The noodles were undercooked and didn't taste homemade at all. It was like they'd just been taken out of the bag and left on the plate to soak up the broth. The only thing that was good was the broth. The meat was unchewable; it formed two clumps in my mouth that I had to spit out into a napkin. For the price, Lanzhou nearby is a thousand times better—cheaper, and they make the noodles right in front of you; they taste great. (Original) Me gusta mucho el ramen normalmente, y este ha dejado mucho que desear. Hay muchos tiktoks recomendándolo y es mucha publicidad fake. Los fideos están poco hechos, y no saben a caseros. Parece que los hayan sacado de la bolsa y te los hayan dejado en el plato haciéndose con el caldo. Lo único que estaba de locos era el caldo. La carne no se podía masticar, se me hicieron dos bolas en la boca que tuve que escupir en una servilleta. Para el precio mil veces mejor el lanzhou que hay cerca, más barato y hacen los fideos delante de ti, saben muy bien.

reviews.author: Nataliia Mishchenko
reviews.text: I honestly don’t even know where to begin because this was such a wonderful experience from start to finish. The food was fantastic, the atmosphere was beautiful, and there was such a lovely harmony throughout the restaurant. But Navin deserves a special mention. In all the restaurants I have visited, I genuinely cannot remember meeting someone who brings such amazing energy to their work. His smile, kindness, bubbly personality and incredibly positive attitude completely stood out. His service was exceptional, but it was much more than just good service. You could genuinely feel his warmth, hospitality and pure kindness. He made us feel welcome, looked after and comfortable from the moment we arrived. His recommendations were absolutely spot-on and honestly made the experience even better. Some people simply do their job, while others have a way of making the whole place feel better just by being there. Navin is definitely the latter. I really struggle to find the right words to describe the positive vibes and wonderful energy he brings to the restaurant. He is a real asset to the team and deserves to be recognised. And I also want to mention the lovely girl who was cleaning the tables towards the end of the evening. I noticed her happily doing her work while having a cute little dance to the music, and honestly, I loved seeing that. It perfectly captured the atmosphere of the whole place — people enjoying what they do, good energy, smiles and genuine harmony. That little moment really stayed with me. ❤️ Amazing food, amazing atmosphere, and truly amazing people. Maki Shoreditch has created something special, and employees like Navin make the experience unforgettable. Thank you, Navin, and thank you to the whole team. I will definitely be coming back! ❤️🍣✨

reviews.author: wy zheung
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my dining experience at Maki Nori in Soho! They specialise in hand-rolled Japanese sushi, and their Omakase Set is only £33 for 15 pieces. The ingredients were fresh, fresh, fresh! For a restaurant in central London, I think it offers really good value for money. Overall, I was very impressed with the quality of the food, the flavours, the atmosphere and the price. I especially loved that the hand rolls are made fresh to order. The nori was still wonderfully crispy when served, and the combination with the fresh ingredients was a real highlight!
